observable_outcome: docs/product/definition.md section 7 states the measured pause semantics -- under any mode other than allow no authoritative durable effect is constructed at all, so pause intake and pause claim also deny claim, result acceptance and every outbox effect kind, leaving only checkpoint (and, under pause claim, Requirement intake) -- and the per-mode allowed-cell counts behind that sentence are asserted by TestStopModeByKindMatrix, which the document cites by name. internal/domain is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: A1. Measure first, and do not trust prior prose. Assert the per-mode allowed-cell counts yourself. The expected values are allow=8, pause-intake=1 (checkpoint only), pause-claim=2 (Requirement intake and checkpoint), graceful-stop=1 (checkpoint only), immediate-stop=0, emergency-stop=0, cancel=0, total 12 of 56. Note that V2-019's a12 evidence summary records pause-intake=2/8 (capture, checkpoint) and a total of 13/56; that prose is wrong because the matrix drives Capture as domain.PermitIntake and pause-intake denies exactly PermitIntake. If your measurement disagrees with the expected values above, stop and escalate rather than adjusting either the numbers or the document to fit.

A2. Anchor the claim in the test. In internal/application/stop_matrix_test.go add, inside TestStopModeByKindMatrix, a per-mode allowed-cell count assertion against a named table declaring the seven expected counts and their total, so the documented sentence has a test that breaks if the gate changes. Keep the top-level test name, the existing wantStopMatrixCells total assertion and the existing graceful-stop-allows-only-checkpoint assertion exactly as they are. Add nothing that requires internal/domain to change and nothing that re-derives the M1 closure proof.

A3. Rewrite the two pause bullets in docs/product/definition.md section 7 (currently at lines 142 and 143) verbatim as follows. Replace "- **pause intake**: 新しいRequirementの受付またはqueue投入を止める" with "- **pause intake**: 新しいRequirementの受付またはqueue投入を止める。allow以外のmodeであるため、実行中の仕事に残る操作はcheckpointの保存だけになる". Replace "- **pause claim**: 新しい仕事のclaimを止め、実行中の仕事は定義済みの境界まで進める" with "- **pause claim**: 新しい仕事のclaimを止める。実行中の仕事が進める「定義済みの境界」はcheckpointであり、結果の受理や外部副作用の確定はできない". Change no other bullet in that list.

A4. Insert one new paragraph immediately after the seven-item control list in section 7, before the existing paragraph beginning "停止commandの受付だけを成功とみなさない", with exactly this content (line-wrapped to match the surrounding paragraphs' width; wording unchanged): "pauseはmode名が示す入口だけを閉じる制御ではない。allow以外のどのmodeでも、durableな副作用を伴うauthoritative effectは一切構成されない（effectの唯一の構成経路が、current effective modeがallowであることを要求する）。したがってpause intake／pause claimの下でも、claim、実行結果の受理、outboxのintegration／promotion／preview-deploy／external-effectはすべて拒否される。実測は7 mode×8 kind＝56 cellのmatrixで確認しており、許可されるcellはallow=8、pause-claim=2（Requirement受付とcheckpoint）、pause-intake=1（checkpointのみ）、graceful-stop=1（checkpointのみ）、immediate stop／emergency stop／cancel=0、合計12である。この閉包はM1 gateがinvariant 2として証明した設計であり、pauseを「新規受付だけを止める弱い制御」と読むことはできない。" Then append to that paragraph one sentence naming the anchoring test, of the form: このcell数はinternal/applicationのTestStopModeByKindMatrixが検証している。

A5. Do not weaken or reinterpret the invariant. The document must say that pause stops strictly more than its name suggests, never less, and must not describe the closure as a limitation to be lifted. internal/domain is not edited and no test asserting the closure is relaxed.

constraints: Work only inside the assigned isolated task worktree; never push.
Never use git reset, git checkout --, git stash or git commit --amend.
Do not touch ci/components.json, Makefile, go.mod, go.sum or devbox.*; the component dependency DAG and the toolchain surface are V2-045's task.
Do not touch .agents/v2/task-state/** or .agents/v2/packets/**; the coordinator records transitions and packets.

Determinism is acceptance, not preference: no fixed sleep, no wall-clock timer, no goroutine in any new test. Waiting is expressed only as bounded deadline polling with an injected clock, and a measured duration is logged as an observation, never asserted as a threshold.
A skipped test is never counted as a pass (gate rule G7). Record every skip explicitly with its status "skipped" and its reason.
Record the execution environment identifier (uname -srm, go version, devbox environment) in the evidence.
Never write a verification as passed that was not actually executed. If an acceptance item cannot be satisfied, stop and escalate to the tech_lead rather than fabricating or weakening it.
Do not start a real Provider CLI (codex/claude/opencode) and do not touch any Google Cloud resource.
Every pre-existing test must keep passing under its existing name. Report the before and after top-level test counts per touched package.
Do not edit internal/domain. Relaxing the L3 closure so that pause-intake or pause-claim would permit an effect is prohibited: it would weaken the closure the M1 gate proved as invariant 2.
Do not change internal/application/service.go or outbox.go; this task changes a document and adds one assertion to an existing test.
Do not copy the per-mode counts from V2-019's evidence prose; measure them.
